nobox.final_span:
Valley and Roaring Fork schools aim to rebalance the mental health marijuana tax funds.
Interestingly, children this fall will have more choices for getting aid.
In addition to what Martin described as a “leveled up mental health system” run by Eagle County’s Total Health Alliance, Colorado Crisis Service has announced a brand-new Trevor Project Crisis Line for teens. And, Martin added, the regional psychiatric clinic for children—Child and Family services—has obtained its state license and is now operational.
Steps Forward in Mental Health: Supports, Case Management, Community Services, Treatment.
In the autumn of 2017 at the Eagle County Peak Parenting class, Kate Eastwood, executive director of the Vail Health Mental Health Institute, discussed what constitutes a healthy community and the broad reach of the Mental Health Alliance.
Although the community extensively discussed youth mental health, she reminded the class about her three-year plan for the Alliance. She had divided her game plan into four sections and what she considered to be “Early Warning Indicators.” The initial part involves school-based counseling services.
This week, the County Commissioner was the first to get there. Betsy Ward and Gwen Lachelt joined commissioner Jeanne McQueeney to spend 95 percent of the time in a meeting to discuss the implementation of services.
Many barriers exist that prevent kids from accessing mental health services. It takes preplanning. It requires the family, teacher, and counselor to recognize that a child is struggling and to organize access to help. Getting the appropriate application for a professional to evaluate the child and determine suitable treatment options can be time-consuming and, at times, overwhelming for children and their families. Sometimes, these options may be seen as lacking. The process can be intimidating or uncomfortable, which may hinder kids or families from advocating for their needs. Or, they can settle for the status quo when it isn't always what, or nearly what, is best for the child's care.
